clips.speaker: 沃伦·巴菲特
clips.short_title: 巴菲特：对手占优的游戏，我不玩

lines.en: I don't want to play in a game where the other guy has an advantage.
lines.zh: 对手占优势的游戏，我不想参与。

lines.en: I could spend all my time thinking about technology for the next year
lines.zh: 就算接下来一整年，我把全部时间都花在研究科技公司上，

lines.en: and I wouldn't be the 100th, 1,000th or even the 10,000th smartest guy in the country in analyzing those businesses.
lines.zh: 在分析这类企业的人里，我也排不进全美前一百、前一千，甚至前一万名。

lines.en: That's a seven- or eight-foot bar that I can't clear.
lines.zh: 那是一根七八英尺高的横杆，我跳不过去。

clips.speaker: 查理·芒格
clips.topic: 互联网泡沫：葡萄干与粪便
clips.short_title: 芒格2000年痛批互联网泡沫

lines.en: If you mix raisins with turds, they're still turds.
lines.zh: 把葡萄干和粪便混在一起，得到的还是粪便。

lines.en: If you had put $10,000 in an index fund and reinvested the dividends, it would now be worth $51 million.
lines.zh: 如果当年把一万美元投进指数基金，股息再投入，现在会变成五千一百万美元。

lines.en: If you had bought gold with that $10,000, you would have about $400,000.
lines.zh: 如果用这一万美元买黄金，现在大约只有四十万美元。

lines.en: All you had to do was figure that America was going to do well over time,
lines.zh: 你唯一需要判断的，就是美国长期会越来越好，

lines.en: that we would overcome the current difficulties.
lines.zh: 我们终将渡过眼前的难关。

clips.speaker: 沃伦·巴菲特
clips.topic: 全场起立致敬约翰·博格
clips.short_title: 巴菲特请全场起立，致敬指数基金之父

lines.en: Jack Bogle has probably done more for the American investor than any man in the country.
lines.zh: 约翰·博格为美国普通投资者做的事，可能比全国任何人都多。

lines.en: People have talked about index funds, but it wouldn't have happened without him.
lines.zh: 很多人都谈过指数基金，但没有他，指数基金就不会诞生。

lines.en: He's put tens and tens of billions into their pockets,
lines.zh: 他已经往投资者口袋里放了几百亿美元，

lines.en: and those numbers are going to be hundreds and hundreds of billions over time.
lines.zh: 随着时间推移，这个数字会变成几千亿。

clips.speaker: 沃伦·巴菲特
clips.topic: 1989年市值前二十，如今一家不剩
clips.short_title: 30年前全球最值钱的20家公司，今天一家都不在了

lines.en: Look at the top 20 from 1989.
lines.zh: 看看1989年市值最高的二十家公司。

lines.en: None of the 20 from 30 years ago are on the present list. Zero.
lines.zh: 三十年前的这二十家，没有一家还在今天的榜单上。一家都没有。

lines.en: The world can change in very dramatic ways.
lines.zh: 世界可以发生翻天覆地的变化。

lines.en: I think there's a great argument for index funds.
lines.zh: 这正是支持指数基金的有力理由。

clips.speaker: 查理·芒格 & 沃伦·巴菲特
clips.short_title: 芒格：没看懂谷歌，我像个蠢驴

lines.en: I feel like a horse's ass for not identifying Google better.
lines.zh: 没能早点看懂谷歌，我觉得自己像头蠢驴。

lines.en: He's saying we blew it.
lines.zh: 他的意思是：我们搞砸了。

clips.speaker: 沃伦·巴菲特
clips.short_title: 巴菲特清仓航空股：那是我的错

lines.en: The world has changed for the airlines.
lines.zh: 航空业的世界已经变了。

lines.en: And I don't know how it's changed.
lines.zh: 而我并不知道它变成了什么样。

lines.en: That was my mistake.
lines.zh: 那是我的错。

lines.en: I wish them well.
lines.zh: 我祝他们一切顺利。

clips.speaker: 沃伦·巴菲特
clips.topic: 25美元也不买全世界的比特币
clips.short_title: 巴菲特：全世界的比特币卖我25美元，我也不要

lines.en: If you told me you own all of the bitcoin in the world and you offered it to me for $25, I wouldn't take it,
lines.zh: 如果你说你拥有全世界所有的比特币，开价25美元卖给我，我也不会要，

lines.en: because what would I do with it?
lines.zh: 因为我拿它有什么用呢？

lines.en: If you said, for a 1% interest in all the farmland in the United States, pay our group $25 billion, I'll write you a check this afternoon.
lines.zh: 但如果你说，全美国农田的1%，作价250亿美元卖给我们，我今天下午就给你开支票。

lines.en: The apartments are going to produce rent and the farms are going to produce food.
lines.zh: 公寓会产生租金，农田会产出粮食。

lines.en: It doesn't produce anything.
lines.zh: 而它（比特币）什么都不产出。

clips.speaker: 查理·芒格
clips.short_title: 芒格：比特币同时占了三样

lines.en: In my life, I try to avoid things that are stupid and evil and make me look bad in comparison with somebody else.
lines.zh: 这辈子我一直尽量避开三种东西：愚蠢的、邪恶的、会让我跟别人一比显得很糟的。

lines.en: And bitcoin does all three.
lines.zh: 比特币三样全占了。

lines.en: In the first place, it's stupid because it's still likely to go to zero.
lines.zh: 第一，它很愚蠢，因为它仍然很可能归零。

lines.en: It's evil because it undermines the Federal Reserve System.
lines.zh: 第二，它很邪恶，因为它破坏了美联储体系。

lines.en: And third, it makes us look foolish compared to the Communist leader in China. He was smart enough to ban bitcoin in China.
lines.zh: 第三，跟中国领导人相比，它让我们显得很愚蠢——他很明智，在中国禁止了比特币。

clips.speaker: 沃伦·巴菲特
clips.topic: 最好的投资是投资自己
clips.short_title: 巴菲特：通胀时代最好的投资

lines.en: The best thing you can do is to be exceptionally good at something.
lines.zh: 你能做的最好的事，就是在某件事上做到极其出色。

lines.en: The best investment by far is anything that develops yourself.
lines.zh: 到目前为止最好的投资，是任何能提升你自己的投资。

lines.en: Whatever abilities you have can't be taken away from you.
lines.zh: 你拥有的能力，谁也拿不走。

lines.en: They can't actually be inflated away from you.
lines.zh: 通货膨胀也夺不走。

clips.speaker: 查理·芒格
clips.short_title: 99岁芒格最后一次股东大会：成功其实很简单

lines.en: It's so simple to spend less than you earn,
lines.zh: 其实很简单：花的比赚的少，

lines.en: and invest shrewdly, and avoid toxic people and toxic activities,
lines.zh: 精明地投资，远离有毒的人和有毒的事，

lines.en: and try and keep learning all your life, and do a lot of deferred gratification.
lines.zh: 一辈子坚持学习，多做延迟满足。

lines.en: If you do all those things, you are almost certain to succeed.
lines.zh: 这些都做到了，你几乎一定会成功。

lines.en: If you don't, you're going to need a lot of luck.
lines.zh: 做不到，你就需要很多运气。

clips.speaker: 沃伦·巴菲特
clips.topic: 宣布交棒格雷格·阿贝尔

lines.en: I think the time has arrived where Greg should become the chief executive officer of the company at year end.
lines.zh: 我认为时候到了：格雷格应当在年底出任公司首席执行官。

lines.en: I want to spring that on the directors, effectively, and give that as my recommendation.
lines.zh: 我要把这件事直接告诉董事们，作为我的正式建议。
